title: feat: split me-code into me-draft and me-craft skills
body:
## Summary

- **me-draft** — requirements review, codebase analysis, and development planning (phases 1–2); outputs a confirmed plan ready for me-craft
- **me-craft** — implementation, testing, commit, push, and MR creation (phases 0–5); includes domain references and implementation-focused code analysis rules
- Both skills have scoped `rules/code-analysis.md`: me-draft uses exploration tools (semantic search, context tree), me-craft uses implementation safety tools (blast radius, static analysis)

## Test plan

- [ ] Trigger me-draft with a ticket/spec and verify it stops at plan confirmation without writing code
- [ ] Trigger me-craft with a confirmed plan and verify it runs branch safety → implement → test → commit → push → MR
- [ ] Verify phase numbers are sequential and internally consistent in each skill
